change: Quick-slot support skills default to self; remove false monster-distance approach behavior.
rules: Generic12 BUFF/support skills cast from quick slots default to player/caster.
No target-distance or auto-approach check is performed for self-default support skills.
Self-ground support skills (e.g. Sanctuary) remain centered on the player.
Ground Protection uses the player position when invoked as a support quick-slot self cast.
Enemy-directed movement skills are not converted to self cast.
